this at Wikidata Miss World is the oldest existing international beauty pageant. It was created in the United Kingdom by Eric Morley in 1951 . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] Since his death in 2000 , Morley's widow, Julia Morley , has chaired the pageant. [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Along with Miss Universe , Miss International , and Miss Earth , it is one of the Big Four beauty pageants .
